solve-feature.description: Run one feature's ready-for-agent issues in order on one branch, each by a fresh coder subagent gated by the project's checks, in a draft PR; at the end it is reviewed by crew-review, its findings fixed, its body written and marked ready when nothing needs a person.

crew-review.description: A fresh read-only subagent reviews a branch or PR against the spec its caller names, for what breaks and for the repo's documented rules, and writes one JSON report; it posts nothing and marks nothing ready.

tdd.description: Test-driven development with red-green-refactor loop, vertical slices.

dep-install.description: Install the project's dependencies once, on the host or in docker.

solve-issue.description: Implement a single issue end-to-end: read, explore, install, TDD, verify, commit.

address-pr-comments.description: Fetch PR review comments, challenge each critically, implement sensible ones with TDD, commit and push.

to-issues.description: Break a plan or PRD into independently-grabbable issues using tracer-bullet vertical slices.

to-prd.description: Synthesize conversation context into a PRD and publish to the issue tracker.

crew-brainstorm.description: Collaborative design pipeline: explore intent, propose approaches, build a spec, then hand off to to-issues.

crew-grill.description: Adversarial design pipeline: stress-test every assumption, capture decisions, then hand off to to-issues.

add-tests.description: Discover the project's coverage command, rank under-covered files by risk, resolve a mocking convention per ecosystem, and hand findings to to-issues as ready-for-agent issues.

upgrade-deps.description: Audit outdated npm/yarn/pnpm dependencies and plan safe upgrades as issues.

configure-tracker.description: Choose where the project's issues live: local markdown files or GitHub Issues.

domain-modeling.description: Updates CONTEXT.md glossary and creates ADRs inline as design decisions crystallise.

write-pr.description: Write a short PR body for a human reviewer: Why, What changes, Risk and Tested.
